description:
Holographic Phygital Conference Plan Generator — one core, any country. A small, standard-library Python program that generates a WorldHoloBridge conference plan for one country from a country profile. The ACOA brief is the fixed content (six conference phases, five holographic tiers, twelve governance rules, the adopted demo tiers, the 90-day Country Node pilot); the country profile is the variable content (languages, cultural authorities, flagship sectors, venues, funding body, disability organizations, consent law).

Built-in profiles: Canada, Morocco, Germany, France, United Kingdom. A new country is a copied JSON file, no code change. Every generated plan is checked by 19 tests for all six phases, all five tiers, both worked examples (Hall of Memory museum, Cadre artistique publicity), the full twelve-rule governance checklist, and the demo tiers at the adopted prices. Venue and date stay blank in every generated plan until confirmed.

All ideas are sparkainlp-x's own. Third-party products (Looking Glass, Sony ELF-MN1) and the Marie Curie example figure are named as products and examples, not claimed as ideas. The companion plan document sets out the framework: one conference, two engines; demos by appointment; the code open, the service the product; consent first, sponsor firewall, guardrails that cannot be disabled.
title: Holographic Phygital Conference Plan Generator: one core, any country
